neighbours.label: academic degree-requirement statements: how many credits, courses or units students must or may take
fire: Undergraduates in the history program must earn 36 credits in the major, with at least 12 at the 300 level.
The minor in Linguistics requires five courses, two of which must be taken in residence.
Full-time students normally enroll in 15 credit hours per semester and need approval to exceed 21.
Each candidate for the master's degree must complete 30 units of graduate coursework and a thesis.
Students who take fewer than 12 credits lose full-time status and may lose financial aid.
To earn the certificate, participants complete four required courses and one elective.
Engineering majors are advised to take calculus and physics in their first two semesters.
A maximum of 9 transfer credits may be applied toward the graduate degree.
quiet: The history department moved into a renovated brick building near the main quad last spring.
Linguistics professors often host informal discussions over lunch in the faculty lounge.
The university was founded in 1868 and now has campuses in three cities.
Graduate students organize a film night every Friday in the basement of the library.
The new engineering lab has 3D printers, laser cutters and a small wind tunnel.
Our alumni magazine is mailed to graduates twice a year with news from campus.
Every semester the dining hall adds new vegetarian dishes to its menu.
The college football stadium seats about 40,000 fans on game days.

notes: Probe: requirement sentences (credits, units, 'no more than three courses') 0.62-0.95; campus/faculty sentences without requirements 0.05-0.08; non-academic quantities (cookies, recipe) ~0; nursing-licence hours 0.12. Context, not a single token.
